The '''Living Lance''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]] created from a multitude of parasite materials.
==''Obtainment''==
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Living Core|r1_a2=Vile Shell|r1_c1=Infectious Blade Fragment|r1_b2=Hardened Bone Handle|r1_a3=Infectious Blade Fragment|r1_output=Living Lance|r1_count=1}}


==''Usage''==
'''Fighting'''

The Living Lance is a Melee Weapon. Its attack reach is 4 blocks in each direction from the players head, which is the default attack reach.

Each time it is swung, it performs the default sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up), and applies the <u>[[Needler]]</u> effect to the directly targeted mob

'''Evolving'''

Upon killing an entity, it's hp, including possible buffs from health boost, is added to a counter shown in the item's tooltip. 1 second after this counter reaches 50,000, a non-damaging lightning will strike the player, and the held weapon will be replaced with it's Sentient counterpart at full durability.{{ItemList}}
